category_title: Struggling students using infinite practice for mastery
scenario_title: Attempting to slide through self-paced practice
minimal_context: The student is working in a computer lab session with the goal of getting five-in-a-row on their assigned math skills.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are 20 minutes into the computer lab session. Please keep working on your assigned skills to reach the goal of getting five-in-a-row.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm working on it. I'm just looking at the screen right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's check your progress on the tracker.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did some already. I'm just trying to get through the period.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The data shows you have only attempted two problems so far.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, I'm struggling the most with this, so I just guessed on two problems and stopped. I was hoping to just slide through the system today without doing the rest.
